suppress.notes:
False positive for Spring Security 7.1.2.
CVE-2026-47842 affects Spring Security 7.1.0 only. The vulnerability was fixed in version 7.1.1. Spring Security 7.1.2 includes the fix.
Re-evaluate when updating the resolved dependency version.

False positive for Spring Security 7.1.2.
CVE-2026-47838 affects previous Spring Security 5.x and 6.x releases. Spring Security 7.1.x is not listed as affected by the official vendor advisory.
Re-evaluate when updating the resolved dependency version.

Temporary risk acceptance — not a false positive.
Springdoc OpenAPI 3.2.0 resolves Swagger UI WebJar 5.34.0, which bundles DOMPurify 3.4.16.
DOMPurify 3.4.16 is affected by CVE-2026-116803. The fixed version is 3.4.17.
Forcing Swagger UI 5.34.1 caused Swagger UI resources to return HTTP 404 in this application. The override was therefore removed to restore compatibility.
Swagger UI and OpenAPI endpoints are enabled only under the local profile and are not exposed under the prod profile.
This suppression is temporary and must be reviewed before 2026-12-01. Do not renew without reassessing the dependency upgrade options.
